description: A React component for rendering and editing Markdown within a dashboard, including resize, focus, and mode toggle functionalities.

classes.name: Markdown
classes.description: A React component for displaying and editing Markdown content with resize and mode toggle features.

methods.name: setEditor
methods.description: Sets the editor instance and configures wrap mode.

methods.name: handleChangeFocus
methods.description: Handles focus state changes and toggles between edit and preview modes.

methods.name: handleChangeEditorMode
methods.description: Switches between 'edit' and 'preview' modes and updates markdown content if switching to preview.

methods.name: updateMarkdownContent
methods.description: Updates the component's markdown code in the parent component.

methods.name: handleMarkdownChange
methods.description: Updates the markdown source in the component state.

methods.name: handleResizeStart
methods.description: Handles resize start event, updates markdown if in edit mode.

methods.name: shouldFocusMarkdown
methods.description: Determines if the markdown editor should receive focus based on event target.

methods.name: renderEditMode
methods.description: Renders the markdown editor for editing.

methods.name: renderPreviewMode
methods.description: Renders the markdown content in preview mode.
